If I could change one thing about iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, it would be disabling that newly added design that summons Siri AI through a downward swipe gesture. There are already enough ways to invoke Siri, yet this new method specifically interrupts my muscle memory for opening the Notification Center on iPhone and iPad.

Meanwhile, on the Mac front it's almost all good news—macOS 27 Golden Gate is performing excellently. Even in late August, new test builds are still adding welcome changes. However, before macOS 27 officially launches next month, I still hope to see one adjustment.

macOS 27 Golden Gate makes MacBook battery percentage harder to read

macOS 27 Golden Gate has redesigned the battery control in the menu bar. By default, the percentage is not displayed—only a battery-shaped visual icon appears.

Actually it doesn't look bad in this state. I also turn off the percentage on my iPhone, because the battery icon design is the same. But on the Mac, I've always tended to show the percentage.

If you enable the "Show Percentage" option in macOS 27 Golden Gate, the number is placed inside the battery icon. I assume this is meant to stay consistent with how iOS 27 handles it on iPhone.

Embedding the percentage inside the battery icon on iPhone was a dense layout solution Apple adopted to free up space next to the notch or Dynamic Island. On the Mac, however—even in the menu bar—this kind of screen space issue doesn't really exist for me.

I've been running macOS 27 Golden Gate on my 15-inch MacBook Air since the first day the initial developer beta dropped. I find myself paying less attention to the battery percentage overall, because it's not as easy for my eyes to read.

I hope Apple will revisit this design decision in the future, especially if it's bothering more users. Until then, I've at least solved the problem myself.

I used Codex to write a simple menu bar widget that clearly and explicitly displays the current battery status and percentage, matching the visual effect I'd expect. If you find it useful too, you can download and install it for free here.
